payout_quote: Compensation: Chief Judge $300, Judge $250, Assistant $200, $25 training (each role).
steps: Complete the Cabarrus County Board of Elections Election Official / Election Volunteer Application (mail to PO Box 1315, Concord, NC 28025; email elections@cabarruscounty.us; fax 704-920-2831; in person 369 Church Street N, Concord, NC 28025; or apply online).
Attend all required training sessions conducted by the Board of Elections before each election ($25 training compensation).
Be able to work from 5:30 AM until 9:00 PM on Election Day.
Serve at the assigned precinct: Chief Judge heads Election Day activities and picks up/returns supplies; Judges work with the Chief; Assistants serve where needed.
catches: Not all officials are assigned to work every election — appointment is per-election by the Board of Elections.
Fixed per-role Election Day stipend: $300 Chief Judge / $250 Judge / $200 Assistant, plus $25 for training attendance.
Workers cannot leave the polling site during the day except in an emergency; must arrange food and drinks for the entire day.
Officials must be registered voters and residents of Cabarrus County, of good repute, able to read and write; cannot be an elected official, candidate, or candidate/party manager or treasurer.
biggest_catch: Long Election Day: 5:30 AM until 9:00 PM (15.5 hours) with no leaving the site except emergencies; fixed $200-$300 per day by role plus $25 training.
eligibility: Must be a registered voter and resident of Cabarrus County; 18+; of good repute; able to read and write; able to lift 30 lbs; basic computer skills; own transportation; must not be an elected government official, a candidate for nomination or election, or a candidate/party manager or treasurer; relatives of candidates barred per NC law; party-balance rules apply.
timing: Election Day: work from 5:30 AM until 9:00 PM (15.5 hours). Training sessions required before each election.
